definitions.webshops.pending: Status draft, awaiting_verification, verification_failed or pending_review; pending_review is waiting for an admin.
definitions.consumers.registered: Active consumer-intent accounts, including webshop members; active platform staff and configured test_account_public_ids excluded.
definitions.consumers.active_in_period: Active consumers who signed in during the period.
definitions.vouchers.issued_in_period: Vouchers whose issued_at is in the period (reserved claims are not issued).
definitions.vouchers.outstanding: Issued, not expired, with an available/issued code that is not invalidated or mismatched.
definitions.vouchers.available_codes: Codes in inventory that are not reserved, issued, redeemed or invalid.
definitions.orders.confirmed_paid_in_period: Orders whose paid_at (provider-confirmed payment) is in the period.
definitions.affiliate_commissions: Network commissions by our status, summed per currency; pending, approved, rejected and reversed are never added together. Headline card shows confirmed (approved) only.
definitions.affiliate_channels: Issued vouchers grouped by explicit approved non-duplicate acquisition transaction with matching consumer and webshop; absent or invalid evidence is Other/Unknown.
definitions.wallets: Consumer wallets per unit: credits issued, debits spent and expiries in the period; outstanding = available + reserved now (liability, not profit); pending (not yet credited) is separate.
definitions.open_actions: Pending webshop reviews, unresolved support reviews and unique webshop connections with errors/failed webhooks plus affiliate connections in error. Incident occurrences and failed jobs are diagnostic, not additive.
definitions.incidents: Counts of recorded technical faults and failures; access denials are audited 401/403 responses.
